nom: Kopari Beauty Bright As Day Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.titre: please bring back the antioxidant face shield!!
avis.texte: This formula is okay, its just not as good in my opinion as the Kopari antioxidant face shield. Both are zinc based mineral sunscreen. The previous formula was my favorite face sunscreen ever!!
Simply wonderful no chalking feeling it's sheer and light. Love it.
I use this as a sunscreen and foundation because it is so light and gives my overall scan of glow while protecting it with SPF of 50
This is the best facial sunscreen. It feels good and it works

I really like this sunscreen as it works really nicely under makeup. It blends effortlessly and leaves a nice finish. However, as I was applying it I noticed a strange smell to this product. It almost smells like corn? It's a bit off putting.
Love this every day sunscreen. Sheer just as the name says. Not greasy. Great for your face!

Although this prodcut does have an unpleasant smell; the texture (serum like), the way it lays on the skin, and the overall shade of the product is worth smelling the smell for what? 2 seconds? Until its rubbed into the skin, it doesnt last at all!! Like guess what also smells terrible? C.E. Ferulic by skin ceuticals and thats been in the top 3 best vitamin c serums in over 10 years! Just hold your breathe while putting it on :) Plus side is you won't have to worry about your skin having an allergic reaction to a frgrance! It shouldnt be added to skin care in the first place!! Anyway, this prodcut is really really great! Worth the buy IMO! AND it doesnt mattify your face like other tinted moisturizers! Its a subtle glow! Only reason for four stars instead of five is I wish that the prodcut was a little bigger!

I received this as a sample size free gift. I used it for one day and it was fine. On day 2 my face started to itch and had a redness throughout. By that night I was completely red, and my entire face was irritated and itches and has a slight burning sensation. I'm not sure what ingredient would cause this bad of a reaction, but its been several days and my skin is still not better. I recommend testing the product on a different area first.

I put some in my hands and tried to rub them together to put the sunscreen on my face and they like stuck together. It was the weirdest sensation. Wherever this product touches your skin, it stays but not in a good way. I got a haircut later and when I tried to brush hair off my face, it prevented my hand from gliding over my cheek and the hair was just glued there. I had to wash my face to get the tiny hair fragments off. I usally use Dermalogica which does have an oily texture but I'd rather have that then whatever this is.
My dermatologist wanted me to use a mineral sunscreen and this is a great option. It is smoother and more hydrating than most and no "ghost" look from the zinc.

avis.titre: Not the product I was looking for
avis.texte: This is hard for me to rate as I was looking for a tinted moisturizer. I was approached by what I thought was an ULTA employee and surprised that she didn't know anything about the products I was asking about. Then she told me she knew the perfect product that she wears all the time and led me to the Kopari products. I was under the impression that this sunscreen was tinted and would be a good replacement for makeup so I bought it on her recommendation. When I checked out I found out she was a rep for Kopari and completely steered me away from what I was really looking for. I am returning it.

avis.titre: Bright as day sheer mineral sunscreen
avis.texte: I love, love, love this product, and I am so happy I ordered it!!!! It is sheer and goes well with all my makeup. I can put it on throughout the day if I am outside!!! I have to give a shout out to Angie Hot and Flashy for giving a great review. She is how I found it. Would highly recommend this product

Really pretty coverage. I believe it only comes in one color and it just happens to work with my skin tone. I'm light with pink undertones. My one complaint is that It's not a big bottle. I would need to replenish soon.

avis.titre: Can't get passed the unpleasant smell
avis.texte: I just cannot get oassed how bad this product smells. It goed on okay and easy to apply but I do not think it makes a big difference in evening my skin tone. Agree with some others that its hard to keep the applicator clean since it requires shaking. I would not buy again.

avis.titre: It smells like a wet dog
avis.texte: It has a very unpleasant odor, doesn't absorb in the skin easily and makes a huge mess (very thin consistency - the tip leaks SO much product out and its wasted in the lid.
I absolutely love this spf on my face . I wear it every morning after my cleaning routine. It is very light with great coverage

I, too, was influenced to purchase this one and wanted to love it. After trying to work with it several times, here is the final verdict: - orangey hue: looks good from a distance, maybe bronzes and perks up my fair skin, so at first it was a plus. But, when using the recommended amount, it gets thick and orangey and hard to blend. Left an orangey line around my jaw a-la 7th grade foundation (Xennial here). - after reading reviews, I checked out the sunscreen in direct sunlight—sure enough, sparkles a la Twilight. - had an unusual chin irritation spot yesterday. Was it this? Only thing different in my routine, cleared up by morning. On the plus side, I experienced no bad smell (and I have a sensitive sniffer), and no chunks. Price was OK in total, but it is high per volume. Will not repurchase or wear this one out of the house much.

This mineral sunscreen is a dream for everyday wear. The sheer, lightweight formula blends seamlessly into the skin‚Äîno white cast, no heaviness‚Äîjust a smooth, hydrated finish with a healthy glow. Infused with skin-loving ingredients, it provides powerful SPF 50 protection while nourishing and brightening the complexion. It layers perfectly under makeup or wears beautifully on its own. Compared to other mineral sunscreens, this one feels more moisturizing and never chalky. A perfect pick for effortless, radiant sun protection every day. Gifted by koparibeauty.

avis.titre: Love how this looks on my skin!
avis.texte: I recently received a bottle of Bright As Day Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 complimentary from Kopari Beauty, and I really like this sunscreen! It not only doesn't leave a white cast on my face, it leaves me with a beautiful glow to my skin. I apply every two hours, and have had no problems whatsoever (and I am fair/burn very easily). I would definitely buy this!

This SPF 50 mineral sunscreen melts in seamlessly. There no white cast either! Just a sheer, glowy finish that flatters every skin tone. Lightweight, protective, and perfect for daily wear. Gifted by Kopari.

I absolutely love this brand! I love how she the sunscreen is, and it feels so light on my skin. Unlike other sunscreens, it also does not make me feel or look oily, which I really appreciate. Will totally re-purchase once I run out. Gifted by kopari

My favorite sunscreen! The texture is super lightweight, Doesn't clog the pores and makes the skin look glowing, moisturized and healthy. I've been using it every single day for the past 2 weeks and I'm in love - the most perfect everyday sunscreen. I've received this product complimentary from kopari beauty.

I've tried the Kopari Beauty Bright As Day Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF‚ÄØ50 and it quickly became my go‚Äëto for everyday sun protection. The formula feels feather‚Äëlight, almost like a second skin, and melts into the skin without leaving that dreaded white cast that many mineral sunscreens have. It gives a subtle, luminous glow that lives up to the "Bright As Day" name, perfect for a natural‚Äëlook finish under makeup or on its own. My skin stayed comfortable and matte all day, even after a long walk in the sun, and I didn't notice any greasy residue or breakouts. In short, It's an elegant blend of high SPF protection and a fresh, sheer finish that feels both luxurious and practical for daily wear. Gifted by Kopari Beauty.

I love this! It gives the most beautiful dewy glow on my face. It is so silky and blends in almost instantly: I love how it feels weightless and definitely can tell it protected my face in the hot sun. This product was Gifted by koparibeauty.

I've been loving this sunscreen! It has a sheer finish that gives me a little extra glow without looking oily. It's a perfect everyday product when I'm wanting a little coverage without the feel of a full face of makeup. (this product was gifted to me by koparibeauty)

Complimentary from koparibeauty I am a Kopari fan and the Bright as Day Sheer Mineral Sunscreen is another good product from the brand. I do notice a brightness when applied and I am hoping that it shows on the photo where I only applied to half of my face. My only complaint is that this can be a bit drying my skin when I am having extra dry skin which I do prefer a sunscreen that also hydrates so this isn't going to become a must have for me.

I've been using this Kopari sunscreen for a few weeks and It's been a great addition to my daily daytime routine! It blends seamlessly into your skin and leaves a beautiful glow. It isn't greasy at all and thankfully Doesn't irritate my skin. I love it! I received this gifted by Kopari.

I really like this mineral sunscreen gifted by Kopari. It's super light and blendable unlike a lot of sunscreens. It wears pretty well under my makeup too which is a must. I'd definitely recommend this sunscreen!

I've been using the Kopari Bright As Day Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50, and I really like it! It's super lightweight, blends easily without a white cast, and gives a natural glow that makes skin look healthy. Perfect for everyday use. Gifted by kopari

Gorgeous! Love the easy to use packaging, as well as the fact that It's a physical sunscreen instead of chemical. It has a tan color but blends right into my lighter toned skin. It seems to even me out a bit, which is great for no makeup days! #giftedbykopari

The bright as day sheer mineral sunscreen works well to protect my skin while I'm out! It feels comfortable on my skin and helps prevent sunburns. The packaging is easy to travel with and reapply too! I was gifted by kopari beauty.

avis.titre: Dewy Mineral SPF of my dreams!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love Kopari's Bright As Day Mineral Sunscreen with SPF 50!! It gives great SPF sun protection without any greasiness, leaving my skin hydrated, protected and looking lit from within all day long! Before + after pictures so y'all can see the stunning dewy finish! Gifted by koparibeauty

avis.titre: I love the glow this gives my skin
avis.texte: This has a a beautiful sheer tint that is super easy to apply with fingers or a brush. I like to wear it alone most days especially when i don't want to wear makeup but I still want my complexion to look even. A little goes a long way so this bottle will most likely last a while. It has helped to simplify my am routine and I've found myself reaching for it daily. 10/10 Complimentary from koparibeauty

Absolutely love this sunscreen! Super light weight on the skin and it gives a natural glow that Doesn't look like you have a greasy complexion. It's a sheer finish so it works for all skin tones. Gifted by Kopari

Such an incredible reliable brand and sunscreen. What I love about this sunscreen is how well it works under Makeup. Some sunscreen's roll and peel off your skin and leave a white cast, which is super inconvenient. This is such an amazing sheer tint sunscreen that leaves no white cast. It makes my skin look better wearing it than not. This was gifted by Kopari Beauty.

avis.titre: Perfect mineral sunscreen for all skintones!
avis.texte: A mineral sunscreen that's sheer and Doesn't leave a white cast on my tan skin is hard to find and this is IT! It has subtle mica that leaves the skin glowy and healthy looking. Gifted by koparibeauty

I'm absolutely loving the Bright As Day Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 from Kopari Beauty, a 100% mineral facial sunscreen that shields against UVA/UVB rays and leaves a sheer, glowy finish. Gifted by Kopari Beauty.

This sunscreen is so elegantly formulated and I am obsessed! Within the past few years I noticed that chemical UV filters were making my eyes water so I had to switch over to mineral sunscreens. I don't mind but not all mineral sunscreens are amazing: sometimes I find they can be too thick, hard to rub in, or cause a blue/white cast (I have light to medium skin time and if I think It's bad I can't imagine I'm someone with even slightly darker skin). This mineral sunscreen is so magical and Doesn't have any of those pain points‚Ä¶it is so thin, is easy to apply, and has a slight tint that blends in seamlessly. My skin is so glowy and bright afterward. It looks good on its own or works well with makeup. Gifted by koparibeauty.

avis.titre: Looks great if the shade works for you!
avis.texte: Well, I will not be able to sue this in the winter. The tint is pretty substantial if you're putting on the recommended amount. However the shade is light enough that I will be able to use it this way in the summer. It'll be too dark in the winter though. This initially has a pretty gross smell lol but fades within 1-2 minutes. This gives a radiant finish but isn't greasy at all, very comfortable to wear! If the shape works for you I would recommend it. For reference I have fair/light skin. Gifted by Kopari beauty

I'm so impressed with this sunscreen! The texture is lightweight and sheer, which is hard to find in a mineral SPF. It blends in beautifully without leaving a heavy white cast, and it feels more like skincare than sunscreen. I love that it gives me broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection while also keeping my skin hydrated and smooth throughout the day. It layers perfectly under makeup and doesn't pill, which is a huge plus. On top of that, It's reef-safe and clean, so I feel good about using it daily. Definitely my new go-to for everyday sun protection gifted by Kopari

This is a gorgeous mineral sunscreen. It did not feel heavy or greasy on my skin and the coverage exceeded my expectations. My skin looked glowy when I wore this and it did help hide small blemishes. It is lightweight and looks nice under makeup‚Äîbut this gives enough coverage and luminosity to get me through "no makeup‚" days as well. I feel confident with just this product on my skin. This matched my fair-to-light skin tone well. I love the ingredients and that this is a cruelty free brand. Gifted by koparibeauty

This sunscreen is all around a joy to use. Nice packaging that dispenses product well. Has a lightweight texture that applies beautifully without tugging. Absorbs nicely leaving a soft matte finish. No greasy or sticky feel. No white-cast on my fair skin. Really creates a nice sheer finish. Comfortable on. Easy to reapply. Definitely an excellent choice for a mineral sunscreen! gifted by Kopari.

avis.titre: Sunscreen that feels and looks like a luxurious treatment.
avis.texte: I've been looking for a product that would simplify my morning routine, and this sunscreen has been the answer. It's so much more than just SPF 50; it's like an illuminating moisturizer and treatment all in one. The first thing you notice is the finish. It leaves your skin with a beautiful, natural glow‚Äîno oily shine or glitter particles. It's that "healthy skin" glow we all strive for. Thanks to the subtle mica and vitamin C, my face looks instantly more awake and radiant. I've used it alone on "no makeup" days, and my skin looks amazing, but under foundation is where it really shines. It acts as a perfect primer, making my makeup look more vibrant and long-lasting. Plus, knowing that while I'm wearing it, the niacinamide is calming my skin and evening out my tone is an incredible bonus.

avis.titre: My skin is so glowy & it protects beautifully
avis.texte: This lovely mineral facial sunscreen is my favorite for every day. I adore it for a few reasons. First of all, it blends in so beautifully and leaves my skin with a glowing finish. It works well on my dry, medium toned skin and absorbs in so quickly. I love that It's completely mineral based and leaves my skin looking brighter and add the protection that I need! Complimentary from koparibeauty

gifted by koparibeauty. This wonderful mineral facial sunscreen is my everyday favorite. It blends seamlessly, provides a soft glow (without being greasy), and works beautifully under makeup. The vitamin C and niacinamide help even out my complexion, and I didn't notice any white casts. It smells great, has fast results, is easy to use, is gentle, and hydrating.

Bright As Day is a standout mineral SPF ‚Äî it blends in sheer, gives a soft glow (without being greasy), and works beautifully under makeup. The addition of vitamin C and niacinamide helps even my tone, and I didn't see any white cast. My skin felt protected and radiant all day. Highly recommend for anyone wanting a clean, lightweight SPF. Gifted by Kopari

This kopari sunscreen It's great! I have dry skin and this formula works amazing for me! Doesn't feel sticky at all! I also lovee the packaging. Feels super nice on the skin I can't wait to take it on my next vacation.Complimentary from koparibeauty

I recently tried Kopari Beauty's Bright as Day Sheer Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50, and I am thoroughly impressed. The lightweight, non-greasy formula feels invisible on the skin, leaving no white cast. It offers strong sun protection while maintaining a natural finish, perfect for daily use. I appreciate that it's mineral-based and free from harsh chemicals, making it suitable for sensitive skin. Highly recommended for those seeking reliable, clean sun protection! complimentary from koparibeauty

I just started using Kopari's mineral SPF sunscreen and I love it. It's completely sheer, but it gives you a little bit of a shimmer that just makes my skin look alive. I used it in the morning for a day out at the beach and I did not burn all day. I love how lightweight it is and the packaging is adorable. I'll definitely be purchasing it in the future when this one runs out! I also love that it has UVA and UVB protection so It's not just against sun burning but also anti-aging. Gifted by Kopari.

I'm really enjoying this sunscreen! The SPF 50 protection is perfect for everyday errands and being out and about. It blends in easily with a sheer finish as I didn't notice any white cast or heaviness. It layers well under my makeup with no pilling. Gifted by Kopari

I love this sunscreen. Definitely one of the best I have ever used. Has no white cast and blends in on your skin effortlessly. The finish id say at least for me It's a glowy heartily skin finish. Definitely worth it as an everyday sunscreen! Gifted by koparibeauty

I'm actually surprised by how much I like this! Most sunscreens feel heavy or leave that white cast, but this one just melts in. It's so light I forget I even have it on, and my skin still looks like my skin. Makes it way easier to stay consistent with SPF. Gifted by Kopari 💕

I really like how this sunscreen feels on my skin ‚Äî It's lightweight, blends in smoothly, and doesn't leave me looking chalky like most mineral sunscreens do. The sheer tint gives just enough of a glow, so my skin looks fresh and radiant without feeling greasy. I also love that it has SPF 50 with clean ingredients, so I feel protected and hydrated at the same time. It's definitely become my go-to for everyday wear.

As someone who only uses mineral sunscreen, this has to be one of my favorites. The formula is smooth and light, and layers well with my makeup. It also blends into my tan skin and doesn't leave an obvious white cast. Gifted by kopari

I am enjoying this sheer tinted spf it fits on my neutral light skin tone to give and effortless look with a good SPF 50 protection. I like that it doesn't sting or cause me any irritation. The best of this is that is great to carry around your purse so I don't forget to reapply. Gifted by koparibeauty

I'm obsessed with this sunscreen. It's sheer and perfect for my skin tone. I've traveled everywhere with it and It's been effective under makeup and doesn't make it pill. The texture is A1 and I'm definitely buying again because It's been my go to!! Complimentary from koparibeauty

this was gifted by Kopari i and tried it out today for the first time. I have fair skin and this gave me such a pretty glow, it is very slightly tinted! It's also very lightweight unlike other sunscreens.

Complimentary from koparibeauty. I love mineral sunscreens but I really dislike any that have a white cast. I have a fair skin tone, and this has a slight beige tint to it so I do not get any white cast. I am not sure if it would be a safe buy for dark skin tones. There's not really any discernible scent, and the finish is really natural and not greasy. Overall I think It's good for anyone who is sensitive to greasy textures or weird scents; I find it really pleasant and easy to forget I put on sunscreen. I really love this and definitely recommend.

Great sunscreen, love mineral sunscreen for everyday use as it doesn't break me out at all. Goes on sheer and does not leave any white cast. Makeup layers nicely on top and doesn't pill at all. Gifted by Kopari Beauty

I love what a beautiful sheer finish this sunscreen leaves! I'm a lighter makeup person on the day to day and this providers just the perfect very light coverage but still a nice smoothing effect on the skin while feeling amazing!This was Complimentary from koparibeauty

It blends in effortlessly and doesn't leave behind that heavy, chalky white cast that can be such a struggle with zinc oxide-based sunscreens. Instead, it gives my skin the prettiest subtle glow, almost like a natural radiance that makes my complexion look more even and healthy without looking greasy or overly shiny. It's formulated with vitamin C and niacinamide, which means while I'm protecting my skin from the sun, I'm also getting brightening and soothing benefits at the same time. I've noticed my skin looks smoother and more refreshed when I wear it regularly, and it layers beautifully under makeup or even on its own. It doesn't pill or feel heavy, which makes it a perfect everyday sunscreen. Love this complimentary from kopari

I absolutely love this tinted sun screen! Complimentary from koparibeauty, I have been looking for a good tinted spf as I don't like to wear heavy foundation every day, and this is perfect! My new everyday spf, and I am obsessed!
Very light feeling and perfectly tinted Works great. My favorite sunscreen

I had quite a serious reaction to this product--red, irritated facial skin and swollen eyes. I have used a multitude of mineral sunscreens and have not had any other reactions. My initial review of the ingredient deck makes me think it might be the clove extract, but can't be certain. I did really like this product upon initial application .

I usually have issues with facial sunsceens (color is off, skin becomes irritated…) this sunscreen, although pricey, is WORTH EVERY PENNY!!! Color blends easily into my skin, is lightweight, and doesnt cause irritation. It protects my skin even on the beach in Maui! I will purchase this again!!

I love mineral sunscreen, this is one I might purchase again, but it is expensive. I like that it's tinted and doesn't have any white cast, but there is a little bit of a granular feeling to it. It rubs in pretty quick and the bottle lasted quite a while.

Love the texture and application, feels great on the skin, but the "universal" tint looks like bad orange self tanner on my very fair, neutral to cool skin. I had the same problem with the Violette spf, sadly. Wish there was an untinted version, or a range of tints, as I expect this would be too warm and light on dark to deep skins tones as well.

Im shocked at how amazing this is. Its SO LIGHT and dries down to be completely undetectable on the skin. Zero, and i mean zero heaviness or grease. The tint is pretty much non-existent! I have no idea why people are saying its not good for fair skin - the tint disappears. There is no scent either. Its just so incredible. Its HEAVEN under makeup too. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS! Kopari really hit it out the park with this formulation.

Unlike all other facial sunscreens I have tried, this one goes on easily. No white film, no greasy feelings. It makes my skin look refreshed. Buying an extra one to keep on our boat! Oh and my skin has improved drastically since I started using it 3 weeks ago.

Unfortunately i got an allergic reaction to this sunscreen. I have acne-prone, dry skin thats super sensitive and got this recommended to me but unfortunately it did make my skin super red and itchy for a couple days after using it. I also had dry patches for about a week after use.

As some of the other reviewers have said, the color is not great on fair skin. It does come across as a bronzer, and somehow the shine in the formula seems to accentuate every wrinkle and pore. The smell is the reason that I'm returning it though. When you first bring your hands to your face to apply, there's a definitely whiff of a sour smell (like foot odor). It dissipates quickly, but I can't handle first thing in the morning every day :-(
Goes on easily and has a comfortable texture. Works well to diminish chance of sunburns.

Fantastic sunscreen! I have just spent almost $100 on another product and it doesn't even come close. At first I thought it was a sunscreen for younger skin, but I wanted to try it anyway. I'm so so so glad I did! It's the best match for my skin tone and it gives me such a nice glow. It also doesn't go into every fine line it finds...it smooths things over. It also re-applies really well because it doesn't feel cakey at all and doesn't pill. Just lovely product at a decent price

avis.titre: Love this for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I'm not sure why some of the reviews are bad. I find this sunscreen light, non-greasy, and doesn't irritate my skin. I don't see any glitter and the scent is nonexistent to me. Definitely will repurchase.

This has quickly become my favorite sunscreen. Every time I use it, someone compliments me on my skin. I have NO idea what other reviewers mean when they reference glitter. I just applied it and made sure to shake extra long and don't see glitter. There is a slight shimmer, but nothing close to glitter, in my opinion. It also doesn't break me out, which can be an issue for me with sunscreen. My only complaint is that it doesn't play as well with makeup as I would like.

ok guys I read reviews saying there was glitter. I had been using this for a week no issue. I went on a vacation with this and noticed glitter on my face and hands....turns out I wasn't shaking the bottle before applying. But while traveling the bottle was being shifted around and mixed up the glitter. I'm not talking about gold dust shimmer....I'm talking actual glitter for possible craft time. I really hate glitter I had take all my makeup off to get rid of it all . If you like that much glitter pieces on your face then cool! you might love this one! but for me the glitter just drives me nuts. the formula is ok ...it didn't irritate my skin. I would prob

avis.titre: Good product - color is not good
avis.texte: The product itself is fine but the color isn'tsuitable for everyone. I would love to see this in a light neutral shade

I love this product. I use it as my foundation as it is light, glowy and I get compliments on my skin when I wear it. I have not encountered chunks, ( I shake like crazy as mineral sunscreens need it.) it is easily applied over moisture and concealer. The scent dissipates quickly. I have mature, dry, sensitive skin and have not experienced cakiness, dryness or irritation. I am a fan of this product.

I really really like it, i have tried many spf with color, and this one i can tell is one of my favorites so far, dont know why it has received so many bad reviews, it doesn feel greasy or dry, it doesnt smells bad like many people says, is like chocolate scent, it leaves little glitter but doesn look bad, you can barely notice, the shade is really good on me, others are too dark, or pink, this one is the perfect shade, I've even received compliments on how my skin looks, im kind of yellow pale skin color, so i strongly thinking on buying the full size, after i finish my Kosas.

This was recommended to me by an Ulta sales associate and when I sampled it, loved it. However when i used it at home there are gritty particles in it that do not go awaw no matter how much you shake it. There are much better options out there.

Chemical UV filter ingredient Butyloctyl Salicylate gave me a horrible skin rash that sent me to ER. I do not recommend! Not a true Mineral Sunscreen. If you have sensitive skin or allergic to chemical sunscreen please do not use. Avoid those chemicals sunscreens.

avis.titre: Smells so bad I almost gag when applying it; small sand bits
avis.texte: These would be a decent sunscreen except the mica is not ground finely enough and it literally feels like I'm plastering sand on my face...'scratch' that...it feels like I'm plastering sand with excrement on my face. I typically only review positively, but this product is such a disappointment, especially with a price point that high. Before applying, I have to steel myself for the incoming stench. The sand particles stay on the skin and make makeup application tricky. I've resorted to only using this product on my neck and chest. Will absolutely NEVER repurchase.
This is one of my favorites. Covers and provides a nice base of sunscreen. Lightweight, I sometimes I forget I have it on. This one I use for work or if I'm going out.
The smell upon application is awful! No lie, it smells like dog poop. Although the scent does go away, it also has a lot of shimmer. The shimmer is more like glitter.

I may sound giddy, but I have tried soooo many face lotions with sunscreen and while I've found many I like (and many I'll never get again), this one is exceptional! I think I've found my dream product for everyday use! ‚ÄúBright as Day‚Äù goes on creamy yet light, soaks right in, produces a lovely glow, and has a high SPF. It doesn't look like I have anything on my face, just a warm natural glow. Also, as a vegan for ethical reasons, I appreciate that all Kopari's products are vegan.

This sunscreen goes on looking a little more tan/bronzer than I'd like, so I have been wearing it under make up, but like other people have mentioned; it does feel like a microdermabrasion or like it's got little beads in there or something, and I have shaken it vigorously. I feel like for the price, I'm not gonna buy it again as I think that there are better sunscreens out there even from kopari, but I haven't been sunburnt yet when using it. It just wasn't what I expected and I don't see any glitter in it as other people have said, but I'm really pale so it leaves a bronzer look than I'd like, so I usually cover mine with a tinted Foundation/medium coverage foundation.

Thoroughly confused by all the people complaining about glitter and it (supposedly, allegedly) hurting so bad that it feels like microdermabrasion (yeah… sure… right). I have this and after applying I cannot aee ANY glitter AT ALL. Just a lovely glow- not like a highlighter glow, just a very natural skinlike glow- and the slightest bit of evening out of my skin. No scratching or microdermabrasion feeling (obviously). Definitely a fan of this and I hope my skin continues to tolerate it because it looks and feels great!
I like this formula and how it wears. But, the smell is terrible. I'll use up what I have, however, I will not repurchase it. If you are bothered by scents, absolutely do not buy this.

avis.titre: Smells bad but has good sun protection
avis.texte: it's less of a tint and more of a shimmery sunscreen. it's blendable, very liquid (make sure to shake first!) but will pill under foundation even if you let it dry. Great for dry skin, smells old and funky, but that dissipates over time. has fair staying power but will rub off on clothes. fair-med skin with hyperpigmentation and redness. not sensitive.

As someone with dry, sensitive skin, I appreciate the easy application, sheer coverage and especially the SPF 50 protection. The formula leaves a soft sheen on the skin. It's not "glitter." This is a great product but probably not for oily skin or for those who prefer a matte look.

I boutgt 3 of tjese during the last 21 days of beauty, and i cracked one open last month. I was excited because very few new and unique formulations of aunscreen come out in the usa. Umfortunately, after appltibg this ro my face … for an entire 6 weeks (because I paid for this torture), I feel deep regret. From tjrpment it touches your skin, to a few seconds after applying, yoy feel like you are getting microdermabrasion (and we know, you have to wait weeks between sessions)… on the plus side, i felt protected from the sun and the shade of the sunscreen was almost the shade of my skin. 10/10 do not recommend
I bought this with high hopes. However every time I use this, there are gritty bits in it. Not tons but like 5 grains of sand every use. I will not repurchase. Also stings/irritates my eyes.

I personally love this sunscreen. People are complaining about the scent, it is not that bad and goes away after it dries. Its a sheer sunscreen that leaves you glowing. If you are not into the "glowing" look I would not recommend this sunscreen. I don't have any problems with grittiness, its smooth for me.

Love this sunscreen! I was looking for a healthier option over a chemical sunscreen. Yes it does have an odor when first applying, but it does go away fast. It also has a few tiny bits of grittiness to each application. Be sure and shake it thoroughly. Apply your skincare beforehand as a mineral suncreen can be a bit drying if you are on the dryer side. My tinted moisturizer and makeup layers nicely over it. As an esthetician of over 35 years I'd recommend daily for skin protection.

This is perfect for me. I use it under my foundations. I don't get any bad smells. To me it smells like nothing. The first time I wore it, my husband commented on how pretty my skin looked that day. SPF 50, I love it!
This has what feels like grains of sand in it, and they don't dissolve on your face. I'd share a picture if it was possible. It also has a bad smell. I will never buy this again.

avis.titre: I would buy this again if it was on sale.
avis.texte: This is a great Isdin dupe. It's very similar and more cost effective. It goes on nicely and spreads evenly. It did not make my face break out which is a plus. If I didn't get it on sale I might not want to spend that much money on a sunscreen though.

avis.titre: Smells Awful and Too Much Glitter
avis.texte: The smell is horrible. It does go away but I dont like gagging during my facial routine. And the glitter is way too much.

To me this smells like dog poop initially, but that fades quickly. The dealbreaker is the glitter. It makes your whole face super shimmery, like I noticed it rubbed off my face and all over my baby. It also has a pretty strong dark tint on fair skin. I don't like it!
Smooth, sheer sunscreen that applies smoothly and gives me just a little brightness.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again.
avis.texte: The product has a sour smell when I first apply it on my face. I will use it on my hands for sun protection til used up.

I have fair dry skin, 51 yrs old. This is the first non-chemical sunscreen I have found that looks invisible under makeup, AND does not make my skin feel dry by the end of the day. I am not seeing the glitter a few have touched on. Will update if I do
I'm 60 plus, take care of my skin, love the spf sunscreen! Great for those that do not like heavy makeup.

avis.titre: Day 1 and it's already my new fave
avis.texte: I wear tinted sunscreen every day. I have melasma and it's finally lighted up over the years (also recently started using Kopari's Vitamin C serum and LOVE it). I tried this sunscreen for the first time today and as soon as I applied it, I loved it. I also got a compliment about my skin today - specifically how bright and dewy my faced looked. This is going to become my go-to sunscreen. It's thin, blends in instantly and looks amazing.

If you're trying to avoid silicones in skin care, this is not a product for you The product description states this is formulated without silicone. However, the ingredient list includes Phenyl Trimethicone. This is classified as a silicone. It's a derivative of dimethicone with a phenyl group added.
Did I actually find a concealer that I'm not allergic to? YES I DID! It's a very light tint but I love it! And I can get daily sun protection!
This sunscreen goes on smooth and does not feel heavy or sticky. It leaves a nice shimmer that's not too much.
I am using this as my foundation. Never thought a mineral sunscreen could be so natural and moisturizing! I am hooked.

avis.titre: The BEST Sunscreen I Have Ever Used
avis.texte: This by far is the best sunscreen I've ever used. This formula blends & melted into my skin so perfectly. I love the micro shimmer in it! I dont wear makeup on a daily basis so it adds a nice subtle pizazz to my skin without overdoing it. Most sunscreens irritate my skin and causes my pores to be clogged. Ive been using this for over a month daily and my skin has been flourishing and loving this lightweight yet moisturizing formula. This has become a skincare necessity for me and will for sure remain one of my holy grail products.

Formula feels great on skin, thin, not drying, love the tint. I thought i finally found my go to face sunscreen. Dealbreaker- has micro glitter in it that shines through foundation. Especially in the sun it looks like i fell into a bag of fairy dust. Kopari, why did u mess up orherwise decent formula? I was going to get it for my husband but he wont touch it because of the micro glitter in it. Please remove the silly sparkles from formula and u will double the purchasing demographic!

I got so excited at first— thin, non-drying formula that finally didnt suffocate my skin. Applied foundation and the rest of makup and looked closely in the mirror. Kopari, why on earth did u decide to put micro glitter in it??? Even with foundation on top, i could see tiny glitter specks all over my face. Not a good look when you sit in a work meeting and the sun hits your face… I was also going to get it for my son since its lightly tinted and he has rosacea but he wouldnt even touch it since it has glitter. Please Kopari, remove this gimmicky glitter because otherwise i loved the formula.

This was ok, not because is a bad product, i have excesive dry skin and also bery sensitive, I wanted to give this a try but i broke out, i know is more because of me than the product itself, this does not mean i will stop buying Kopari products
I love this , the only negative is as soon as you squeeze it has an odd smell that eventually disappears. Otherwise I love it for daily use .

I got this product as a recommendation. I hate stand alone sunscreens and they dont work well on my skin. Then i try this one and fell in love. I used it every day. I buy my second bottle and when i use it, it feels gritty like im using a gentle exfoliating scrub. I thought it was user error and maybe i hadnt shaken the bottle good enough. I gave it a second try and had the same results. I never felt the grit in the first bottle. I thought it was a fluke thing so i went to ulta and bought another bottle and had the same problem. I will be returning. Im not sure what happened but i loved the first bottle and im so sad the next two have not been the same.
This stuff is awesome - i plan i using it even in the cold winter months

I've used over a hundred of sunscreen brands and this is probably my favorite. It's lightweight, easy to apply, no white cast, beautiful finish, I'll wait for some promotion and get many of this because I finished so quickly. I sent a sample of this Sunscreen to my best friend in Brazil and she doesn't wear sunscreen because of the smell, greasy finish, white cast but this one? She loved it, I don't think Kopari sells in Brazil but I'll bring it to her when I travel there

I bought this "on a whim" at Ulta last weekend and I am SO happy I did! I really didn't "need" it, but it was so pretty on my hand when the sales associate tried it out, so I thought I'd try it and let me just say...WOW!!! I use this daily under my makeup and my face is so smooth and glowy and my makeup looks great..ALL DAY! I don't think I will ever NOT use it.
